verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API covering core object/space/type/property/template CRUD and querying, plus an MCP server that exposes these via natural language, and a CLI for headless/automation use — a substantial subset of UI functionality is API-reachable. However, several UI-only features (web publishing setup, membership/ANY ID management, import/export wizards, graph view, template gallery customization) are not documented as API-accessible, and there's no independent confirmation of full UI/API parity. missing for 10: evidence that publishing, import/export, membership, and collaboration-sharing flows are fully API-accessible; independent/hands-on confirmation of API completeness vs UI; official parity statement or changelog showing API keeping pace with UI features.
